name: sshhh/sshhh
description: SSHhh — Deployments so quiet, you can hear a server drop. Self-hosted PWA SSH Deployer with AES-256-GCM credential vault, 1-click live streaming pipelines, and complete event logging.

scripts.lint: php -r "$it = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator('.')); foreach ($it as $f) { if ($f->isFile() && $f->getExtension() === 'php' && !str_contains(str_replace('\\', '/', $f->getPathname()), '/vendor/')) { passthru('php -l ' . escapeshellarg($f->getPathname()), $code); if ($code !== 0) exit($code); } }"
